brief:
A settlement outpost in the occupied West Bank known as "Gefen Ami" has grown from a small group of young settlers into a broader community of families, Eye on Palestine reported. The expansion is documented in promotional material released by the outpost itself.

The outpost's transformation reflects wider patterns of settlement growth in the occupied territory, where unauthorized Israeli outposts have proliferated despite international legal challenges and Palestinian objections to their presence.
dek: A settlement outpost in the occupied West Bank that began with a handful of young settlers has grown into a community of families, according to a promotional video from the so-called “Gefen Ami” outpost.
title: West Bank outpost expands from young settlers to established community
